Module com.example.miniproyecto_50zo
Package com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.model

Class GameModelTest.RecordingObserver

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.model.GameModelTest.RecordingObserver
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver
Enclosing class:
GameModelTest
private static class GameModelTest.RecordingObserver extends Object implements GameObserver
Test double implementation of GameObserver that records which notification methods were called during a test. Used to verify that the GameModel fires the correct events.
